posts.title: Stone Age Art and Animals in Southern Africa
posts.description: Lions, leopards, hyenas and rhinoceroses once roamed the European landscape with ancient humans, and artists painted these animals with exquisite detail and beauty in a limestone cave now in France. On my recent visit to safari camps in South Africa, I saw these same animals in their bush environment.

posts.title: Moqui Marbles and Water on Mars
posts.description: Iron-rich, marble-sized concretions, formed through interaction with water over millions of years, weather out of the Navajo Sandstone formation in southern Utah. During searches for evidence of water and life on Mars, researchers discovered small metallic concretions that are remarkably similar to those in the Navajo Sandstone.

posts.title: The Devastating June 2026 Earthquakes in Venezuela
posts.description: Two deadly earthquakes rocked northwestern Venezuela on June 24, 2026. In a remarkable sequence, a magnitude 7.2 foreshock was followed 39 seconds later by a magnitude 7.5 mainshock. The region has had many large historical earthquakes, so these events were not especially surprising. However, the high numbers of fatalities and injuries, along with widespread damage, are staggering and tragic.
